Package dev.px.core.command

Class CommandRegistry

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.registry.Registry<Command>
dev.px.core.command.CommandRegistry
All Implemented Interfaces:
Named, Service, Iterable<Command>
public final class CommandRegistry extends Registry<Command> implements Service
The registered commands, and the chat hook that dispatches them.

The old CommandManager registered a chat listener whose body was empty, so no command ever ran. Dispatch lives here: a message starting with the prefix is parsed, cancelled so it never reaches the server, and routed.

Cancelling is the important part and is easy to get wrong in the other order. The event is cancelled before the command body runs, so a command that throws still cannot leak the raw text to the server.
